sloka: त्वाम् दृष्ट्वा पुत्र जीवामि रामे सभ्रातृके गते ।वृत्ते दशरथे राज्नि नाथ एकः त्वम् अद्य नः ॥२-८७-१०॥
transliteration: tvām dṛṣṭvā putra jīvāmi rāme sabhrātṛke gate ।vṛtte daśarathe rājni nātha ekaḥ tvam adya naḥ ॥2-87-10॥

translations.english: O my son, I hope you have not heard any unpleasant news about Lakshmana or about my only son Rama who has gone to the forest along with his wife.
